name: dbskill
title_zh: 问诊式商业诊断：先查病灶再开药方
tagline_zh: 别拿模板套生意。它像老中医一样先望闻问切，从现金流、客源、定价里揪出真问题，再给能落地的解法，不是一堆正确的废话。
tagline_en: No template patching. It probes cash flow, customers, pricing like a sharp consultant, pinpoints the real.
why_zh: 机制是「先诊断后开方」：不急着给建议，先逼你回答关键数据与场景，用追问链暴露逻辑断点。
why_en: It refuses to prescribe before diagnosing. A chain of pointed questions forces your real numbers and context to surface, so the.
limit_zh: 只做商业逻辑与策略诊断，不碰财务建模、税务合规、法务条款。需要你提供真实经营数据（至少是近似值），否则追问会停在半路。
limit_en: Covers business logic & strategy only—no financial modeling, tax, or legal. Needs real (even approximate) operating data; otherwise the questioning.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Business diagnosis: find the disease before prescribing
